upstream.name: NousResearch/hermes-agent
upstream.notes: ClawHermes now prefers a Windows-native Python venv path when upstream payloads support it. Real Windows verification is still required before marking production-ready.

commands.setup: python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -e .
commands.start: python -c "from hermes_cli.main import main; raise SystemExit(main())" gateway run

integration.summary: Windows-native verification passed on 2026-05-06: source checkout at apps/hermes-agent, Python 3.11 venv setup completed with pip install -e . exit 0, start-adapter launched .venv\\Scripts\\hermes.exe gateway run, and http://127.0.0.1:8642/health returned 200 through control status.

commands.setup: python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip && python3 -m pip install --target vendor/${CLAWHERMES_RUNTIME_KEY} .
commands.start: python3 -c "from hermes_cli.main import main; raise SystemExit(main())" gateway run

integration.summary: macOS adapter uses portable python3 plus a movable vendor/<darwin-arch> dependency directory prepared on a macOS build host; start runs hermes_cli.main from USB_ROOT without reusing the Windows venv.
